name: Harvest Moon Fair
blurb: The Roost is decked out in pumpkins and paper lanterns. Brindle's stall sells pie.

name: Frostfall
blurb: Snow on the Nest, cocoa in the Pantry, and every dragon wants to catch snowflakes.

name: Bloomtide
blurb: Flowers everywhere. Your dragon has sneezed eleven times today.

name: Sunfire Festival
blurb: The longest day of the year. Dragons bask, riders sunburn.
